note: Revocation order: revoke or rotate first, then clean git history. Cleaning first without revoking leaves a live key in clones and caches.

aws.name: AWS access key
aws.rotate: Deactivate the key, create a replacement, update the workload, delete the old key.

verify.detail: caller identity via signed request, manual

github.name: GitHub token
github.rotate: Regenerate the fine-grained token and update CI secrets. Check the audit log for new SSH keys and workflows.

gitlab.name: GitLab token
gitlab.rotate: Revoke the token, issue a scoped replacement, check for new deploy keys.

google.name: Google API key
google.rotate: Delete the key, create a restricted replacement, set API and referrer restrictions.

openai.name: OpenAI key
openai.rotate: Revoke the key, create a project-scoped replacement, check usage and billing.

anthropic.name: Anthropic key
anthropic.rotate: Revoke the key, issue a workspace-scoped replacement, check usage.

deepseek.name: DeepSeek key
deepseek.rotate: Revoke the key and issue a replacement. Check balance and usage.

huggingface.name: Hugging Face token
huggingface.rotate: Revoke the token, create a read-scoped replacement, check repo access.

stripe.name: Stripe key
stripe.rotate: Roll the key, update the server environment, confirm webhooks still verify.

slack.name: Slack token
slack.rotate: Revoke the token in the app settings and reinstall the app if needed.

supabase.name: Supabase key
supabase.rotate: Rotate the JWT secret or the service_role key, then update the client and server env.

mongodb.name: MongoDB connection string
mongodb.rotate: Rotate the database user password and update the connection string.

verify.detail: connect and ping, manual or mongosh

postgres.name: PostgreSQL connection string
postgres.rotate: ALTER ROLE with a new password, update the secret store, restart consumers.

private-key.name: Private key
private-key.rotate: Generate a new key pair, publish the new public key, retire the old one, check for logins.

jwt.name: JSON Web Token
jwt.rotate: Revoke the session or signing key. A JWT stays valid until expiry unless the issuer supports revocation.

generic.name: Generic secret
generic.revoke: the provider that owns the value
generic.rotate: Confirm the type, then revoke at the provider. Generic hits need a human first.

npm.name: npm token
npm.rotate: Revoke the token, issue a granular replacement, check recent publishes.

pypi.name: PyPI token
pypi.rotate: Revoke, issue a project-scoped replacement, check the release history.

discord.name: Discord bot token
discord.rotate: Reset the bot token and update the host.

sendgrid.name: SendGrid key
sendgrid.rotate: Delete the key, create a restricted replacement, check the mail activity log.

telegram.name: Telegram bot token
telegram.rotate: Revoke with /revoke in BotFather and update the host.

twilio.name: Twilio API key
twilio.rotate: Delete the key and create a replacement with a narrow role.

shopify.name: Shopify admin token
shopify.rotate: Uninstall and reinstall the app to rotate the token.

notion.name: Notion integration token
notion.rotate: Refresh the integration secret and update the host.

datadog.name: Datadog API key
datadog.rotate: Delete the key, create a replacement, check the audit trail.
